To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
public debt dynamics in LICs have been influenced not only by the macroeconomic variables, but also by the structure of the debt, and the provision of relief over time.

(1) the determinants of debt accumulation are not only the standard macroeconomic variables but include other factors that have a more direct impact on the debt structure; (2) the debt structure is an important determinant of debt dynamics and debt relief is a major factor in reducing debt in the long-run; and (3) there is a high degree of country heterogeneity and debt dynamics are influenced by country-specific factors.

the determinants of debt dynamics in low income countries include fiscal policy, the exchange rate regime, the composition and the structure of the debt, the provision of debt forgiveness and debt management.
